name: @costrinity/vitna-compliance-mcp
description: VITNA by COSTRINITY produces Ed25519-signed evidence records that anyone can verify offline with a published public key and an open-source verifier, with no need to trust VITNA's servers. Your agent checks a risky action before it runs and gets an allow, block, or hold decision. It is a cooperative guardrail with heuristic detection, and those limits are documented publicly. Zero setup: the first tool call self-provisions a restricted trial key.
author: COSTRINITY (Indigenous-owned software studio, Regina, Saskatchewan, Treaty 4 territory)
